title: FBS Music Album Metadata Schema v1.0.0
description: Domain-specific metadata schema for music albums and releases. Incorporates the FBS Core Metadata Schema via allOf to ensure all core interoperability fields are present. Defined in RFC FBS0001 Section 4.2.4.4.

artists.description: Primary performing artists on this release.

albumTitle.description: Album or release title, if different from the core name field.

label.description: Record label that issued this release.

catalogNumber.description: Label catalog number for this release.

format.description: Physical or digital format of the release.

trackCount.description: Total number of tracks on the release.

discCount.description: Number of discs in the release.

totalDuration.description: Total runtime as an ISO 8601 duration (e.g. 'PT45M30S').

duration.description: Track duration as an ISO 8601 duration (e.g. 'PT3M45S').

artists.description: Featured or guest artists on this track.

tracks.description: Ordered list of tracks on the release.

isrc.description: International Standard Recording Code, applicable for singles.

compilation.description: Whether this is a compilation album.

explicit.description: Whether this release contains explicit content.
